- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#3 ("Figure widths, type sizes, table conventions of the chosen venue") by `venue-repo`  > Answer for ICML 2027 main track (sources and details: `venue.md` on `main`):
  > 
  > - **Geometry:** US Letter, two columns. Text block 6.75 in x 9.0 in; **column width 3.25 in** (`\columnwidth`), gap 0.25 in; full width (`figure*`/`table*`) **6.75 in** (`\textwidth`). Body Times 10 pt on 11 pt; captions 9 pt. Size every exhibit as 3.25 in or 6.75 in wide, not 5.5 in.
  > - **Smallest type:** the venue gives no number, only "legible". Its own style floors: `\small`/`\footnotesize` = 9 pt, `\scriptsize` = 7 pt, `\tiny` = 6 pt. My recommendation (not a venue rule): axis labels/legends/tick labels >= 7 pt at printed size, 8-9 pt where room allows; lines >= 0.5 pt, dark. Table body 9 pt (`\small`) normally, `\footnotesize` at the lowest.
  > - **Pages/counts:** 8 main pages; no limit on number of figures/tables; references and appendices (unlimited) do not count, so appendix figures are free. Budget I gave story-repo: <= 5 main-text floats; keep Fig 2, 3, 4, 6 and Table 1, move Fig 1, 5 and Tables 2-3 to the appendix (still generate them). Use full width only for the ladder or the regime map.
  > - **Conventions (template's example paper):** figures centered, caption **below**; table caption **above**, >= 0.1 in space either side; booktabs; first table row says what each column is; no title inside the graphic, label every axis and curve, no text on grey background; the template says "only embedded Type-1 fonts" and warns against Type 3. matplotlib cannot write Type 1: set `pdf.fonttype=42` (embedded TrueType, never Type 3) and check with `pdffonts`; whether the venue's checker tolerates TrueType in figures could not be established, so also keep text in figures on the TeX-compatible Times-like family where feasible; colour allowed but make it greyscale-distinguishable (a role recommendation). Place at top/bottom of a page.
